turns.text: On a dark desert highway, cool wind in my hair
turns.zh: 在黑暗的沙漠公路上，凉风吹过我的头发

turns.text: Warm smell of colitas, rising up through the air
turns.zh: 空气中飘来温暖的大麻味

turns.text: Up ahead in the distance, I saw a shimmering light
turns.zh: 前方远处，我看见一点闪烁的灯光

turns.text: My head grew heavy and my sight grew dim
turns.zh: 我的头越来越沉，视线越来越模糊

turns.text: I had to stop for the night
turns.zh: 我不得不停下来过夜

turns.text: There she stood in the doorway
turns.zh: 她就站在门口

turns.text: I heard the mission bell
turns.zh: 我听见了教堂的钟声

turns.text: And I was thinking to myself
turns.zh: 我心里暗自琢磨

turns.text: "This could be Heaven or this could be Hell"
turns.zh: 「这可能是天堂，也可能是地狱」

turns.text: Then she lit up a candle
turns.zh: 然后她点起一根蜡烛

turns.text: And she showed me the way
turns.zh: 给我指了路

turns.text: There were voices down the corridor
turns.zh: 走廊那头传来人声

turns.text: I thought I heard them say
turns.zh: 我觉得我听见他们在说

turns.text: "Welcome to the Hotel California
turns.zh: 「欢迎来到加州旅馆

turns.text: Such a lovely place (such a lovely place)
turns.zh: 这么可爱的地方（这么可爱的地方）

turns.text: Such a lovely face
turns.zh: 这么可爱的脸庞

turns.text: Plenty of room at the Hotel California
turns.zh: 加州旅馆房间多的是

turns.text: Any time of year (any time of year)
turns.zh: 一年到头任何时候（任何时候）

turns.text: You can find it here"
turns.zh: 你都能在这儿找到它」

turns.text: Her mind is Tiffany-twisted, she got the Mercedes-Benz, uh
turns.zh: 她满脑子都是蒂芙尼，开着奔驰，嗯

turns.text: She got a lot of pretty, pretty boys she calls friends
turns.zh: 她身边一堆漂亮男孩，她管他们叫朋友

turns.text: How they dance in the courtyard, sweet summer sweat
turns.zh: 他们在院子里跳舞，甜蜜的夏日汗水

turns.text: Some dance to remember, some dance to forget
turns.zh: 有人跳舞为了记住，有人跳舞为了忘记

turns.text: So I called up the Captain, "Please bring me my wine"
turns.zh: 于是我打电话给领班，「请给我来点酒」

turns.text: He said, "We haven't had that spirit here since 1969"
turns.zh: 他说，「1969年以后我们这儿就没那种烈酒了」

turns.text: And still those voices are calling from far away
turns.zh: 那些声音还在远处呼唤

turns.text: Wake you up in the middle of the night
turns.zh: 半夜把你叫醒

turns.text: Just to hear them say
turns.zh: 就为了听他们说

turns.text: "Welcome to the Hotel California
turns.zh: 「欢迎来到加州旅馆

turns.text: Such a lovely place (such a lovely place)
turns.zh: 这么可爱的地方（这么可爱的地方）

turns.text: Such a lovely face
turns.zh: 这么可爱的脸庞

turns.text: They livin' it up at the Hotel California
turns.zh: 他们在加州旅馆尽情享乐

turns.text: What a nice surprise (what a nice surprise)
turns.zh: 真是个惊喜（真是个惊喜）

turns.text: Bring your alibis"
turns.zh: 带上你的不在场证明」

turns.text: Mirrors on the ceiling, the pink champagne on ice
turns.zh: 天花板上镶着镜子，粉红香槟冰镇着

turns.text: And she said, "We are all just prisoners here of our own device"
turns.zh: 她说，「我们在这里都只是自己的囚徒」

turns.text: And in the master's chambers they gathered for the feast
turns.zh: 在主人的房间里，他们聚在一起赴宴

turns.text: They stab it with their steely knives, but they just can't kill the beast
turns.zh: 他们用钢刀刺它，却怎么也杀不死那头野兽

turns.text: Last thing I remember, I was running for the door
turns.zh: 我记得的最后一件事，是我冲向门口

turns.text: I had to find the passage back to the place I was before
turns.zh: 我得找到回去的路，回到我原来的地方

turns.text: "Relax," said the night man, "We are programmed to receive
turns.zh: 「放松点，」守夜人说，「我们天生就是接待客人的

turns.text: You can check out any time you like, but you can never leave"
turns.zh: 你随时都可以退房，但你永远离不开」
